integrity: The necessary-and-sufficient classification follows analytically by component tensor factorization, explicit Gibbs expansions, Pauli product mixtures, single-site partial-transpose negativity, and two-site product expectation witnesses. Finite checks are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The exact classification applies only to a finite qubit Pauli Hamiltonian with term-overlap graph of maximum degree one and concerns full separability. A PPT state can fail to be fully separable. No circuit-level, noisy-state, higher-degree, or efficient arbitrary-precision sampler claim is made.
title: Exact full-separability phase diagram for matching-overlap Pauli Gibbs states
